main_measure.name: mean excess 10-bar forward return after new 20-day closing highs (vs coin mean 10-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 non-overlapping events

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return of events whose next close is below the new high (must be > 0)

decided_by: Inconclusive rule met: the t of the mean excess 10-bar return lies between -2 and 2 with at least 100 events.
reading: A new-high event is a bar whose recorded countdown equals 20 and has a 10-bar forward return in its window; events are kept greedily per window and one less than 10 bars after the last counted event is skipped; the coin mean uses every bar with a 10-bar forward return across all its windows; 'closes below the new high' means close[t+1] < close[t]; the supporting check does not change the status.
